title: [Nichibei] Order Group Impact Detection – Empty impact state – No impact and zero detail returned
description: AC 01.1 — Decision Table — An Order Group without scheduled assignments or consumed points produces an empty impact result.
preconditions:
- HQ or CM Staff is logged in to the Nichibei Salesforce org and can use Developer Console.
- Test Order Group `OG-NB-API-001A` has Assignment LA `LA-NB-API-001A` with `Require Allocation = true` and zero scheduled student sessions.
- Test Order Group `OG-NB-API-001P` has Point LA `LA-NB-API-001P` with `Require Allocation = false` and consumed points of `0`.
- The actual Salesforce IDs for both test Order Groups are recorded for this execution.
steps_actions:
1. "HQ or CM Staff runs one detector request with the recorded IDs for `OG-NB-API-001A` and `OG-NB-API-001P`."
2. "HQ or CM Staff inspects the response impact flags and aggregate values."
3. "HQ or CM Staff inspects the affected allocation IDs and summaries."
steps_result:
1. "One response is returned for the request."
2. "`hasImpact`, `hasAssignment`, and `hasConsumedPoints` are `false`; assigned-session count is `0`; consumed-points total is `0`."
3. "Both affected-allocation ID lists and both summary lists are empty."

title: [Nichibei] Order Group Impact Detection – Scheduled assignment sessions – Assignment impact returned without point impact
description: AC 01.2 — Decision Table — Scheduled sessions are reported from the Assignment LA while consumed points on an out-of-scope Point LA are excluded.
preconditions:
- HQ or CM Staff is logged in to the Nichibei Salesforce org and can use Developer Console.
- Test Order Group `OG-NB-API-002A` has Assignment LA `LA-NB-API-002A` with `Require Allocation = true` and exactly two scheduled student sessions.
- A separate, active Order Group `OG-NB-API-002P` has Point LA `LA-NB-API-002P` with `Require Allocation = false` and consumed points of `4` from those sessions.
- The actual Salesforce ID for `OG-NB-API-002A` is recorded; `OG-NB-API-002P` is deliberately excluded from the request.
steps_actions:
1. "HQ or CM Staff runs the supplied detector request with the recorded ID for `OG-NB-API-002A`."
2. "HQ or CM Staff inspects the assignment section of the response."
3. "HQ or CM Staff inspects the consumed-point section of the response."
steps_result:
1. "One response is returned for the request."
2. "`hasAssignment` and `hasImpact` are `true`; total assigned-session count is `2`; affected assignment ID list contains only `LA-NB-API-002A`; its summary has assigned-session count `2`."
3. "`hasConsumedPoints` is `false`; total consumed points is `0`; consumed-point IDs and summaries are empty."

title: [Nichibei] Order Group Impact Detection – Consumed points without scheduled sessions – Point impact returned without assignment impact
description: AC 01.3 — Decision Table — A point-only Lesson Allocation is reported even when it has no scheduled student session.
preconditions:
- HQ or CM Staff is logged in to the Nichibei Salesforce org and can use Developer Console.
- Test Order Group `OG-NB-API-003P` has Point LA `LA-NB-API-003P` with `Require Allocation = false` and consumed points of `3.5`.
- A separate, active Order Group `OG-NB-API-003A` has Assignment LA `LA-NB-API-003A` with `Require Allocation = true` and two scheduled student sessions.
- The actual Salesforce ID for `OG-NB-API-003P` is recorded; `OG-NB-API-003A` is deliberately excluded from the request.
steps_actions:
1. "HQ or CM Staff runs the supplied detector request with the recorded ID for `OG-NB-API-003P`."
2. "HQ or CM Staff inspects the consumed-point section of the response."
3. "HQ or CM Staff inspects the assignment section of the response."
steps_result:
1. "One response is returned for the request."
2. "`hasConsumedPoints` and `hasImpact` are `true`; total consumed points is `3.5`; affected point ID list contains only `LA-NB-API-003P`; its summary has consumed points `3.5`."
3. "`hasAssignment` is `false`; total assigned-session count is `0`; assignment IDs and summaries are empty because Assignment LA `LA-NB-API-003A` belongs to excluded `OG-NB-API-003A`."

title: [Nichibei] Order Group Impact Detection – Assignment and point impact – Both categories and summaries returned
description: AC 01.4 — Decision Table — The response retains assignment and consumed-point details when both impacts exist.
preconditions:
- HQ or CM Staff is logged in to the Nichibei Salesforce org and can use Developer Console.
- Test Order Group `OG-NB-API-004A` has Assignment LA `LA-NB-API-004A` with `Require Allocation = true` and three scheduled student sessions.
- Separate Test Order Group `OG-NB-API-004P` has Point LA `LA-NB-API-004P` with `Require Allocation = false` and consumed points of `4.25` from those sessions.
- The actual Salesforce IDs for both test Order Groups are recorded for this execution.
steps_actions:
1. "HQ or CM Staff runs one detector request with the recorded IDs for `OG-NB-API-004A` and `OG-NB-API-004P`."
2. "HQ or CM Staff inspects the assignment impact in the response."
3. "HQ or CM Staff inspects the consumed-point impact in the response."
4. "HQ or CM Staff inspects the combined impact flag."
steps_result:
1. "One response is returned for the request."
2. "`hasAssignment` is `true`; total assigned-session count is `3`; the assignment IDs and summaries contain `LA-NB-API-004A` with assigned-session count `3`."
3. "`hasConsumedPoints` is `true`; total consumed points is `4.25`; the point IDs and summaries contain `LA-NB-API-004P` with consumed points `4.25`."
4. "`hasImpact` is `true` and neither category's IDs or summary is omitted."

title: [Nichibei] Order Group Impact Detection – Four Order Groups – Totals and affected allocations aggregated
description: AC 01.5 — Decision Table — One request aggregates distinct assignment and point impact from two supplied Order Groups.
preconditions:
- HQ or CM Staff is logged in to the Nichibei Salesforce org and can use Developer Console.
- Test Order Groups `OG-NB-API-005A1` and `OG-NB-API-005A2` have Assignment LAs `LA-NB-API-005A1` and `LA-NB-API-005A2`, each with `Require Allocation = true` and respectively one and two scheduled student sessions.
- Separate Test Order Groups `OG-NB-API-005P1` and `OG-NB-API-005P2` have Point LAs `LA-NB-API-005P1` and `LA-NB-API-005P2`, each with `Require Allocation = false` and respectively consumed points of `1.5` and `2.75`.
- The actual Salesforce IDs for all four test Order Groups are recorded for this execution.
steps_actions:
1. "HQ or CM Staff runs one detector request containing the recorded IDs for all four test Order Groups."
2. "HQ or CM Staff inspects assignment impact and its summary."
3. "HQ or CM Staff inspects consumed-point impact and its summary."
4. "HQ or CM Staff inspects the combined result."
steps_result:
1. "One aggregated response is returned for the request."
2. "`hasAssignment` is `true`; total assigned-session count is `3`; assignment IDs and summaries contain `LA-NB-API-005A1` with count `1` and `LA-NB-API-005A2` with count `2`."
3. "`hasConsumedPoints` is `true`; total consumed points is `4.25`; point IDs and summaries contain `LA-NB-API-005P1` with points `1.5` and `LA-NB-API-005P2` with points `2.75`."
4. "`hasImpact` is `true`; each affected allocation appears once in the category matching its Require Allocation value."
steps_data:
1. "orderGroupIds = [OG-NB-API-005A1, OG-NB-API-005A2, OG-NB-API-005P1, OG-NB-API-005P2]"
2. "expectedAssignedSessionCount = 3; expectedAssignmentAllocationIds = [LA-NB-API-005A1, LA-NB-API-005A2]"
3. "expectedConsumedPoints = 4.25; expectedConsumedPointAllocationIds = [LA-NB-API-005P1, LA-NB-API-005P2]"
4. "expectedHasImpact = true; expectedDistinctAllocationCount = 4"
